title: Autism in women — the "you have friends" myth (Ellie, 36, teacher)
caption:
Myth: you can't be autistic if you have friends. Masking is why so many women get diagnosed at 36, not 6 (Hull, JADD 2017).
Save this. Which myth next? 👇
www.aiforheratx.org
#autisminwomen #latediagnosedautistic #maskingautism #autisticburnout #neurodivergentwomen #womensmentalhealth

scenes.text: Ellie, 36, teaches third grade. She eats lunch in her car because the staffroom is *loud*.
phrases: She eats lunch in her car.
She's called that 'being difficult' for years.

scenes.text: People kept explaining her to her. Nobody said the word *masking*.
phrases: "I rehearse *hello* in the parking lot first."

scenes.text: Boys get diagnosed about *4×* as often as girls (CDC, 2023). Masking is a big reason (Hull, JADD 2017).

scenes.text: Tonight she filled the free *RAADS-R* and screenshotted the score for her GP.
phrases: Screenshot the score, ask your GP for an adult assessment.
Then drop one demand tomorrow, on purpose.
And walk 20 minutes most days: that's WHO's 150 min/week.
